scope: Artifact identity, the required Linux gate, real Perforce integration on the exact packaged executables, and Debian package lifecycle. Every check listed here passed. No live cloud-provider test was run for this release: read not_run before relying on cloud storage, migration or cold-read acceptance.

checks: tests (full offline suite; available live integration prerequisites)
required_linux_gate.perforce_binaries_present: p4d and p4 2026.1/3089746; the Perforce integration cases ran
required_linux_gate.privileged_watcher_test: The fanotify live-watch case ran with CAP_SYS_ADMIN and did not skip, confirmed by a verbose run of the same test executable.
required_linux_gate.coverage_note: The gate tests executables from its own Cargo build of the same source with the same toolchain; the packaged build is a separate compilation. The packaged bytes are evidenced by packaged_perforce_integration below.

packaged_perforce_integration.runtime: The tar/Debian runtime files above, placed at the paths the integration-test executable launches.
actual_perforce_scenarios: warm and cold archive reads through the packaged daemon and shim
writer submits and mutable RCS archives, historical reads, verification and acknowledged deletion
concurrent cold reads and refused read-only obliterate preserving siblings

debian_package_lifecycle.environment: Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS container user space, glibc 2.39
debian_package_lifecycle.note: The Docker base image excludes package documentation; that exclusion was removed so documentation installs as on an ordinary host. Host systemd and service activation were not exercised.

source_areas_unchanged_since_7_0_0.note: No source file in these areas differs from the 7.0.0 RPM source commit, which the 7.0.0 records identify as carrying the same Rust sources as the 7.0.0 Debian and tar build. The garbage-collection change in this release reads the keystore and catalog through the unchanged storage backends.

not_run.check: Live cloud-provider functional tests (three Amazon S3 cases, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage)
not_run.reason: No provider credentials were available to the release build. The cases report success without contacting a provider when credentials are absent, so their results in the suite totals are not evidence.

not_run.check: S3-backed migration cases on the packaged runtime: live upload with busy-file skip and same-job resume, download and same-job resume, interrupted-job recovery, packaged cold reads after migration
not_run.reason: They need the same S3 credentials. Five integration cases returned without exercising a provider.

not_run.check: Different-UID permission denials and same-UID cold reads on the installed service layout
not_run.reason: Not repeated; the fixture is not part of the source workspace.

not_run.check: Licensing tests with the vendor signer
not_run.reason: No vendor signing key is available to the release build. The workspace's own licensing suites ran in the gate.

not_run.check: Identifier audits of artifacts, packaging source and website
not_run.reason: Not repeated; the audit inputs are not part of the source workspace.

limits: Uploads are asynchronous: loss of a writer and its disks before remote publication can lose unpublished file generations.
Perforce metadata needs independent backups. A live migration pass is a per-file capture, not a transactionally consistent whole-server backup.
Package checksums are not a detached GPG signature or hosted attestation.
No real customer data conversion or production service activation was performed by these tests.
